text: この　おくに　いきやがったら　ただじゃ　おかねえぞ！

structure.jp: この　おくに　いきやがったら
structure.en: if you dare go further in here

structure.jp: ただじゃ　おかねえぞ！

patterns.name: 〜やがる
patterns.explanation: やがる stuck onto a verb shows anger or contempt at the person doing it, like 'dare to'. いきやがったら = 'if you dare go'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: The たら ending means 'if' or 'when' that happens. この　おくに　いきやがったら = 'if you go further in here'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ねえ is the rough tough-guy way to say ない, 'not'. ぞ adds a threatening 'I'm warning you'. ただじゃ　おかねえぞ = 'I won't leave it at that', you won't get away with it.
